environment.memory_note: Not sampled; do not infer memory efficiency

protocol.development: Lowest SHA256(seed:query_id) half of SciFact train query IDs; remainder unused. Reject train/test query-ID overlap.
protocol.document_ranking: Production chunk rankings, including RRF over chunk IDs, collapsed by first occurrence of paper_id; remove query-ID self matches
protocol.embedding: Pinned shipped MiniLM; reject wordpiece overflow, never truncate; no model tuning
protocol.input: UTF-8 title, blank line, text; paragraph-v1 with authoritative Go analyzer; no text truncation
protocol.latency: Single query at a time, warm processes; sparse includes local pipe transport, dense includes query encoding/exhaustive cosine; hybrid includes both and fusion; no HTTP/auth/database overhead
protocol.protocol_revision: 2: input-only preflight found 2 of 41981 SciFact chunks above 256 wordpieces (maximum 387); no held-out evaluation performed before this amendment
protocol.scidocs_policy: No train split exists: transfer SciFact-selected parameters unchanged; never tune SCIDOCS test.
protocol.selection: Maximize mean document nDCG@10 on development only, ties by ascending k1,b,rrf_k. Sparse and hybrid selected independently.
protocol.subset_policy: Smoke only: deterministically lowest document/query hashes, never presented as full benchmark quality
protocol.wordpiece_refinement: analyzer-boundary-wordpiece-v1; opt-in lossless splitting against pinned tokenizer; reject any unsplittable span
